description: Billing summary and payment method, with actions provided by the application.

howToUse: Use it on the billing page: the payment method, the state of the subscription and the next charge.
Show only the last digits in `lastDigits`, never the full card. Put the state in `status` with a Badge.
Put "Change card" and "View invoices" in `actions`. The card data is collected by your payment provider.

keyboard.action: Moves through the actions of the card.

props.name: brandIcon
props.description: Method brand/icon (ReactNode; the DS does not bundle logos). E.g. VISA.

props.name: lastDigits
props.description: Last card digits, shown as "· ending 4242".

props.name: methodMeta
props.description: Secondary line of the method. E.g. "Expires 09/2028 · Asaas (Brazil)".

props.name: status
props.description: Billing status, a slot for `Badge` (e.g. <Badge tone="success" dot>Active</Badge>).

props.name: nextChargeLabel
props.description: Label of the next charge block.

props.name: nextChargeAmount
props.description: Amount of the next charge. E.g. "$ 2,388".

props.name: nextChargeDate
props.description: Date/extra info of the next charge. E.g. "on May 2, 2027".

props.name: actions
props.description: Actions (slot), e.g. Change card, View invoices (`Button`).

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback called when the value changes.
